mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to a negative 20-day forward return in more than 40% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not lead to a negative 60-day forward return in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases over two consecutive quarters but does not lead to a positive 20-day forward return in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -2% does not lead to a negative 5-day forward return in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increase > 0.5% does not lead to a negative 20-day forward return in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST MoM < -10% does not lead to a negative 5-day forward return in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increase > 200,000 does not lead to a positive 20-day forward return in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals robust economic growth and labor market tightening, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: economic expansion with labor market tightening
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases and UNRATE decreases but does not lead to a positive 60-day forward return in more than 70% of the cases.
